Fitting the three bands with a full d⁴ ligand-field calculation gives Dq ≈ 2176 cm⁻¹, B ≈ 725 cm⁻¹ and C = 4.7B ≈ 3408 cm⁻¹. The fit is unique and reproduces the bands to within about 1.5 cm⁻¹.

**Approach.** I did not use a simplified formula. I built the full d⁴ Hamiltonian in the basis of Slater determinants. It combines the Racah electron repulsion (F² = 49B + 7C, F⁴ = 63C/5) with an octahedral field of strength Dq. I computed the Ms = 1 and Ms = 2 blocks and removed the quintet levels from the Ms = 1 block, which left only the triplets. The ground state is ³T₁g, and I took the spin-allowed bands as the lowest three distinct triplet levels above it.

**Fit.** C/B was fixed at 4.7, and Dq and B were varied to match 18 850, 19 750 and 20 560 cm⁻¹. Five different starting points all converged to the same solution.

| Band | Observed (cm⁻¹) | Fit minus observed (cm⁻¹) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 18 850 | +0.6 |
| 2 | 19 750 | −1.5 |
| 3 | 20 560 | +0.9 |

The result is a strong-field complex with 10Dq ≈ 21 760 cm⁻¹ and B about 0.7 of a typical free-ion value.
